Name: Spouse Love Letters
Author: Istoleyourjuice
Description:
You gave them a bouquet. You got down on one knee. And then... nothing. No reaction, no acknowledgment, just the same daily routine.This mod fixes that.After you give a marriage candidate a bouquet, you'll find a letter in your mailbox the next morning. After you propose, you'll get another one. Every candidate has two unique letters written to match their personality, so Alex sounds like Alex and Elliott sounds like Elliott.No generic responses. No copy paste jobs. Just a little moment that makes the whole thing feel real.
[b]Candidates included: [/b]Alex, Abigail, Elliott, Emily, Harvey, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sam, Sebastian, Shane
[b]Also includes letters for Stardew Valley Expanded candidates: [/b]Sophia, Claire, Victor, Olivia, and most recently: LANCE

[b]Requirements: [/b]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (only required if you want the SVE letters)
[/*]
